headline: Russian airstrikes hit Ukrainian aid center
standfirst: Officials report 31 deaths after heavy bombs struck a village in southern Ukraine.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: At least nine massive 3,000kg aerial bombs struck a village in southern Ukraine.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The attack targeted a local aid center, leading to 31 confirmed deaths.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The Ukrainian president described the strike as an utterly horrific act of violence.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates from officials as they assess the damage and identify victims.

caption:
Russian airstrikes on a Ukrainian aid center have resulted in 31 deaths according to local officials.

At least nine 3,000kg bombs were dropped on the southern village. The Ukrainian president has condemned the attack as a horrific tragedy.
